items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: She performed in the States with the Diva Jazz Orchestra, Chico Hamilton, and Nancy Wilson

ctx.x: Saxophonist and composer Karolina Strassmayer has made her mark in the jazz world both in the U.S. and in Germany. She performed in the States with the Diva Jazz Orchestra, Chico Hamilton, and Nancy Wilson, and she currently performs with the WDR Big Band in Cologne and leads the band KLARO! with her husband drummer Drori Mondlak.
Karolina was interviewed via Zoom on May 25, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
